blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two suspected fixers were arrested by Highway Patrol Group (HPG) personnel assigned to the Land Transportation Office (LTO) over their disorderly behavior in the agency’s central office. According to the LTO on Saturday, the two men were arrested after they were not allowed to proceed with their transactions in changing license plates on Oct. 16. READ: LTO suspends license of Makati driver for blocking a pedestrian lane Citing an investigation by the agency’s Intelligence and Investigation Division, the LTO said the two men were processing special license plates for their clients.
